Sông Hàn chia Đà Nẵng thành hai bờ: bờ T: The Han River divides Da Nang into two banks: the west bank is central Hai Chau with Bach Dang, Tran Phu and 2/9 streets; the east bank is Son Tra with the Tran Hung Dao and Le Van Duyet axes looking straight across to the center. Han River apartments are popular because they are in the city core and also have views of the river, the Dragon Bridge, Tran Thi Ly Bridge and the international fireworks every DIFF season. Với căn hộ ven sông, nên xem kỹ ba việc:: For riverside apartments, look carefully at three things: whether the unit is freehold or fixed-term (some hotel apartment and condotel blocks on commercial-service land have a term), whether the project is eligible for sale or has Pink Books yet, and whether the specific unit faces the river directly or is blocked by a neighboring tower. Each project in the table has its own page listing the developer, status and press sources; projects with a price list show reference prices.
